snippet.title: Swordcery - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist and try the demo! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4747730/Swordcery_Demo/

Swordcery is a roguelite ARPG indie game where you can collect and wield an arsenal of spellbound blades! Watch the brand new gameplay trailer!

#swordcery #steamnextfest #roguelike
